hero.lede: knloop explores what a programming language can be when agents are the primary user from day one. The goal is a language that is easy to learn instantly, deterministic to check and repair, standard-library first, and explicit enough that most tasks have one obvious path.
hero.note: The current toolchain is available for exploration, but today's syntax and APIs are not a contract. Expect breaking changes while knloop finds what works best for agents. Run it in safe environments, not production systems.

pillars.label: On demand
pillars.title: A small surface area
pillars.description: knloop aims to be a language agents can learn on the job: regular syntax, very few special cases, and compiler feedback that points to the next edit.

pillars.label: First
pillars.title: Less dependency hunting
pillars.description: The long-term goal is a standard library broad and consistent enough that most programs start from documented APIs instead of choosing packages.

pillars.label: Tool-readable
pillars.title: Deterministic repair loops
pillars.description: The toolchain is designed to expose diagnostics, graphs, size reports, explanations, and fixes as structured data that agents can consume.

features.title: Pre-1.0 by design
features.description: Current syntax and APIs are not a contract. Expect breaking changes while knloop finds what works best for agents.

features.title: Safe environments only
features.description: Security vulnerabilities are expected. Run and develop knloop in isolated environments, not production systems or sensitive infrastructure.

features.title: Exploration over mastery
features.description: Try the current shape, inspect the output, and send feedback. Details will keep shifting as the experiment advances.

features.title: One obvious path
features.description: The language should favor a few regular patterns over many interchangeable styles.

features.title: Stdlib over syntax sugar
features.description: New capabilities should usually exist as documented APIs before they become new syntax.

features.title: Agent-readable toolchain
features.description: Diagnostics, graph facts, size reports, and fix metadata should be available as structured output.

features.title: Explicit side effects
features.description: Access to the outside world, fallibility, and resource use should stay visible to readers and tools.

features.title: No legacy commitments
features.description: When a cleaner agent-oriented design wins, knloop can replace old behavior instead of carrying compatibility paths.

features.title: Developer experience as the goal
features.description: Checking, reviewing, explaining, and fixing code should feel direct, even though the language is deliberately explicit.

direction.label: Direction
direction.title: Regularity over cleverness.
direction.body: knloop favors explicit capabilities and standard-library APIs over syntax for every convenience. If it makes code easier for agents to generate, check, and repair, some code may be more verbose for humans.

cta.title: Explore with us.
cta.body: Install the compiler, run the examples, and see what the experiment can do today. The most useful feedback is anything that helps agents guess less.

footer.tagline: Agent-first language design, still under active exploration.
